RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Friday, the August 18, 2006/Sravana 27, 1928 (Saka)
————
(Ministries : Agriculture; Agro and Rural Industries; Chemicals and Fertilizers;
Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution; Environment and Forests;
Health and Family Welfare; Railways; Small Scale Industries; Steel)
Total number of questions — 20
Review of the National TB Control
Programme
*321. SHRI S.M. LALJAN BASHA:
Will the Minister of HEALTH AND
FAMILY WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have made
some changes in the policies relating to the
National TB Control Programme during
the last six months;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether it is a fact that nodal TB
hospitals like L.R.S. Institute of T.B. and
Respiratory Diseases in Delhi have
become noted for abandoning poor patients
after preliminary medication; and
(d) the steps taken to review and direct
the L.R.S. Institute of T.B. and Respiratory
Diseases and such other institutions to
have a responsible and humane attitude
towards TB patients?
CCTVs at stations in Mumbai
*322. PROF. P.J. KURIEN: Will the
Minister of RAILWAYS be pleased to
state:
(a) the number of closed circuit TVs
(CCTVs) in operation at various suburban
railway stations in Mumbai as on 1st July,
2006;
(b) the details thereof, station-wise;
(c) the actual number of such CCTVs
which were operational and functional as
on 11th and 12th July, 2006; and
(d) the steps proposed to activate such
CCTVs in all vulnerable points in
Mumbai?
Construction of road over bridges in
Andhra Pradesh
*323. SHRI NANDI YELLAIAH: Will
the Minister of RAILWAYS be pleased to
state:
(a) the number of proposals received
from the Government of Andhra Pradesh
for construction of road over bridges
alongwith the details of each such
proposal;
(b) the status of those proposals; and
(c) the time likely to be taken to clear
and implement all those proposals?

101
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Proposal for ROBs/RUBs in
Karnataka
*324. SHRI JANARDHANA
POOJARY: Will the Minister of
RAILWAYS be pleased to state:
(a) whether a number of ROBs/RUBs
have been proposed by Karnataka on the
cost sharing basis to the extent of 50:50;
(b) if so, the details thereof and
Government's reaction thereto;
(c) whether RUB for Bajal-Pandil Road
near Kankanady Railway Station is one such
project pending for implementation since
the year 2000;
(d) if so, the details thereof;
(e) whether the railway authorities are
not implementing this project even after
the local authorities have agreed to meet
the entire cost of the project; and
(f) if so, the Government's reaction
thereto?
Eradication of leprosy
†*325. SHRIMATI PREMA
CARIAPPA:
SHRI MOTILAL VORA:
Will the Minister of HEALTH AND
FAMILY WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are making
continuous efforts for eradication of leprosy
from the country;
(b) if so, the number of leprosy cases
detected, so far, during the current year in
the country, especially in Chhattisgarh;
(c) the reasons for not eliminating
leprosy completely from the States where
there is much prevalence of leprosy; and
(d) whether Government would, with
the help of concerned State Governments,
make some special efforts for eradication
of leprosy?
NRHM in North Eastern Region
*326. SHRI KARNENDU
BHATTACHARJEE: Will the Minister of
HEALTH AND FAMILY WELFARE be
pleased to state:
(a) the progress, so far, made in carrying
out the objectives of the National Rural
Health Mission in the North Eastern
Region, indicating the estimated population
for whom health facilities are still beyond
reach, State-wise;
(b) the allocation of Central funds for
the mission during the current year and
during the preceding three years, and the
population and the area covered under the
mission during each year, State-wise; and
(c) the criteria adopted for allocation of
Central funds for the mission and the steps
taken to ensure the prevention of leakage,
diversion or misappropriation of funds?
Community managed food and water
security system
*327. SHRIMATI MOHSINA
KIDWAI:
SHRI VIJAY J. DARDA:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the National
Commission on Farmers, in its report, has
emphasized the need for community
managed food and water security system
promoted with help and oversight of Gram
Sabhas;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) what action Government propose
to take in this regard?

102
Supply of wheat to Gujarat
*328. SHRI KANJIBHAI PATEL:
SHRI JAYANTILAL BAROT:
Will the Minister of CONSUMER
AFFAIRS, FOOD AND PUBLIC
DISTRIBUTION be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have taken a
decision for increasing the supply of wheat
to Gujarat;
(b) if so, the quantity thereof and the
time by which it is likely to be given to the
State;
(c) whether this increase is going to be
met from the wheat imported recently;
and
(d) if so, whether it would be given in
the form of flour?
New academic session in private
medical colleges
*329. SHRI T.S. BAJWA:
CHOWDHARY
MOHAMMAD ASLAM:
Will the Minister of HEALTH AND
FAMILY WELFARE  be pleased to state:
(a) the number of private medical
colleges recognized and approved by the
Medical Council of India in the country as
on the 15th August, 2006 and the number
of students who got admissions in these
medical colleges during the current academic
session;
(b) whether these colleges have started
their academic session for the new entrants
by now; and
(c) if not, by when the new sessions
are likely to be started in these colleges
and the details of the role of MCI in this
regard?
Telemedicine programme in remote
areas
*330. MS. MABEL REBELLO: Will
the Minister of HEALTH AND FAMILY
WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government plan to extend
the telemedicine programme to the remote
corners of the country to reach out to the poor;
(b) whether Government would
subsidize the programme for the BPL
families;
(c) whether Government would exploit
the programme to its full potential; and
(d) if so, by when and the budgetary/
financial provisions for the same for the
next year?
Ill-effects of improper medicines
†*331. SHRI DATTA MEGHE: Will
the Minister of HEALTH AND FAMILY
WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that millions of
people in our country are affected every
year by taking improper medicines;
(b) whether the Heart Care Foundation
of India has also drawn the attention of
Government in this regard in one of its
reports; and
(c) if so, the steps taken by Government
in this regards?
Plantation of Eucalyptus tree
*332. SHRI ABU ASIM AZMI: Will
the Minister of ENVIRONMENT AND
FORESTS  be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Eucalyptus
(Safaida) tree sucks a larger quantity of
underground water than Neem, Peepal or
Banyan trees in the country and most
particularly in Northern India;
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

103
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
(b) if so, whether due to plantation of
this tree, the ground-water level has gone
down;
(c) whether Government propose to ban
the plantation of this tree and allow
plantation of local trees; and
(d) if so, by when such necessary
instructions are expected to be issued to
the State Governments and if not, the
reasons therefor?
Amendments to Essential
Commodities Act, 1955
†*333. SHRI RAM JETHMALANI:
SHRI RAJ MOHINDER
SINGH MAJITHA:
Will the Minister of CONSUMER
AFFAIRS, FOOD AND PUBLIC
DISTRIBUTION be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that there is a
need to re-amend the Essential
Commodities Act, 1955;
(b) if so, the reaction of Government
thereto; and
(c) the steps Government propose to
take in this direction?
National Policy on Farmers
*334. SHRI SHANTARAM
LAXMAN NAIK: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are proposing
to adopt a National Policy on Farmers;
(b) if so, whether a draft of the policy
has been prepared;
(c) the agencies from whom assistance
has been obtained to prepare the draft; and
(d) the details of essential features of
the draft policy?
Withdrawal of user charges
*335. SHRIMATI HEMA MALINI:
KUMARI NIRMALA
DESHPANDE:
Will the Minister of HEALTH AND
FAMILY WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Members of
Parliament have requested Government to
withdraw the ' anti-people' order on user
charges levied by AIIMS;
(b) if so, whether Government are
considering to withdraw the order as this
would be a big relief to the poor patients; and
(c) by when the order is expected to be
finally withdrawn?
Security arrangements in long
distance trains
†*336. SHRI PYARELAL
KHANDELWAL: Will the Minister of
RAILWAYS be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that there are
many loopholes in the security
arrangements for the passengers in the
trains particularly in the long distance
trains;
(b) whether it is also a fact that
Government have not taken any concrete
measures for the security of passengers
inspite of innumerable incidents of
robberies, lootings and thefts;
(c) if not, the details of the measures
taken particularly with regard to the
reserved bogies of long distance trains
specially at night;
(d) whether Government are considering
to constitute a special Committee to
provide better services and security to
passengers; and
(e) if so, the details thereof?

104
Work plan agreement with Israel
*337. SHRIMATI SHOBHANA
BHARTIA: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) whether India and Israel have signed
a three-year work plan for cooperation in
the field of agriculture;
(b) if so, the details of the agreement;
(c) whether the work plan focuses on
development of agri-business projects,
collaborative research and development,
academic and farmer-level exchanges and
cooperation in gene bank resources;
(d) whether under the agreement, Israel
shall transfer technologies and techniques
relating to post-harvest management and
value addition for fruits, vegetables and
dairy products; and
(e) if so, to what extent it would be
helpful to India?
Funds for controlling Chikungunya
disease
*338. SHRIMATI  S.G. INDIRA:
SHRI C. RAMA-
CHANDRAIAH:
Will the Minister of HEALTH AND
FAMILY WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that 9.7 lakh
suspected cases of Chikungunya were
reported from many States;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether it is also a fact that the States
have demanded more funds to check the
disease; and
(d) if so, the steps taken in this regard?
Forest cover
*339. SHRI MATILAL SARKAR: Will
the Minister of ENVIRONMENT AND
FORESTS be pleased to state:
(a) the percentage of forest land over
the total areas of each State and Union
Territory;
(b) the annual income of Government
from the forest produces and other resources
of the forest land, State-wise and UT-wise;
(c) the number of families evicted from
the forest land before 1st April, 2004 and
after that date; and
(d) the cases of violation of the Forest
Act and rules as on 15th July, 2006
alongwith the details of the present status
of the cases?
Recall system for hazardous foods
*340. SHRI MAHENDRA MOHAN:
Will the Minister of HEALTH AND
FAMILY WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that recently a
detailed scheme has been formulated to
introduce a system for recall of hazardous
foods from the market, if they are
adulterated, misbranded or injurious to
health;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) the details of view expressed by
various State Governments and machinery
established or proposed for effective
implementation of the recall system; and
(d) the details of the recall system for
hazardous foods as practiced in some other
countries?

Ban on mechanized boats
2259. SHRI K. E. ISMAIL: Will the
Minister of AGRICULTURE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the Supreme
Court has issued an order imposing a
uniform fishing ban on mechanized boats
applicable from 10th June to 15th August
2006, in all the five Coastal States i.e.
Gujarat, Maharashtra, Goa, Karnataka and
Kerala;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether it is also a fact that
Karnataka, Kerala and Goa had already
imposed ban till 31st July, 2006; and
(d) if so, the reaction of these three
States extending ban upto 15th August,
2006 and Government's reaction thereto?
Development of floriculture
2260. SHRI SURENDRA LATH: Will
the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have given
emphasis for development of floriculture
during the current Plan;
(b) whether there is any State-wise
target fixed for the purpose;
(c) if so, achievements made till date;
and
(d) the amount spent for this
programme, till date?
Assistance for construction of houses
in Karnataka under Mathsya
Ashraya-II
2261. SHRI K.B. SHANAPPA: Will
the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have given
approval for construction of 5000 houses
under Mathsya Ashraya-II in Karnataka;
(b) if so, the amount released, as on
today; and
(c) if not, by when the amount would
be released?

522
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Waving of loans of farmers
2262. SHRI AMAR SINGH:
SHRI ABU ASIM AZMI:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have received
any demands from the State Governments
to waive the loans of farmers in their States;
(b) if so, the names of the States which
had approached his Ministry in this regard;
and
(c) the action taken in this regard?
Jatropha cultivation
2263. SHRI B.K. HARIPRASAD:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government would
consider exploring the potential of Jatropha
as the ideal feedstock for bio-diesel;
(b) whether Jatropha lends itself to all
geo-climatic conditions, has low gestation
period and high seed yielding potential;
(c) whether according to estimates,
Jatropha cultivation on a mere 11 million
hectares out of the country's total
wasteland area of 63 million hectares has
the potential to save around Rs. 20,000
crores on oil import bill; and
(d) whether Government would launch
a broad policy initiative on the large scale
production of bio-feedstock based on
Jatropha?
Joint action on agriculture and health
2264. SHRIMATI SYEDA
ANWARA TAIMUR:
SHRI VIJAY J. DARDA:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware that
a new initiative to create awareness to
promote joint action on agriculture and
health fronts has been launched by the
Washington based Internal Food Policy
Research Institute;
(b) whether Government would also
propose to reorient relative public policies for
closer ties between the agriculture and health
sector which can be highly rewarding; and
(c) if so, the details thereof?
Assistance to farmers for purchasing
fertilizers, seeds and implements
†2265. SHRI KAMAL AKHTAR:
SHRI SHAHID SIDDIQUI:
SHRIMATI MAYA SINGH:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether any loan or financial
assistance is provided to the farmers for
purchase of fertilizers, seeds and
implements;
(b) if so, the funds provided to Uttar
Pradesh and Madhya Pradesh during the
years 2004-05 and 2005-06 respectively;
and
(c) whether there is any proposal to
effect an increase in the said financial
assistance?
Committee probing into the causes
for suicides
2266. SHRI M.V. MYSURA REDDY:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether the Committee appointed
by the Prime Minister to probe the causes
of growing farmers' suicides has submitted
its report;

523
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the measures recommended to
redress the alarming situation and the action
proposed in the matter?
Suicides in Bundelkhand
2267. KUMARI NIRMALA
DESHPANDE: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) whether a large number of small and
marginal farmers in the backward area of
Bundelkhand, Uttar Pradesh are committing
suicides, but no steps have been taken yet
to help the farmers;
(b) whether there is any proposal to
declare any package for Bundelkhand like
that of Vidarbha; and
(c) if not, the other steps being planned
to help the farmers?
Supply of fertilizers and pesticides to
small/marginal farmers
2268. SHRI T.T.V. DHINAKARAN:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that insufficient
application of fertilizers and pesticides by
farmers result in low yield, affecting
agricultural output;
(b) the estimated loss of production on
account of this; and
(c) the steps taken to provide adequate
fertilizers and pesticides to farmers
particularly to small/marginal farmers to
increase production?
Change in guidelines for relief to
drought hit States
†2269. DR. PRABHA THAKUR:
SHRI SANTOSH
BAGRODIA:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Central Government have
made changes in the existing guidelines to
provide relief to drought hit States in order
to give them lump-sum waiving for one
year on payment of interest on loans for
Kharif crops, to increase the ceiling of
agriculture investment subsidy and to
provide additional assistance to these
States;
(b) if so, the complete details of new
guidelines issued by Centre; and
(c) the extensive details of released/
proposed to be released assistance schemes
and loan schemes by Central Government
for drought hit States especially, for the
farmers of Rajasthan, till date?
Average land of farmers
†2270. DR. MURLI MANOHAR
JOSHI:
SHRI RAVI SHANKAR
PRASAD:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that 80 per cent
farmers are such in the country who are
having 1.41 hectare average land;
(b) if not, the facts in this regard;
(c) whether it is also a fact that these
families are earning their livelihood by
cultivating the said land;
(d) if so, the reaction of Government;
and

524
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
(e) the assessment with regard to
maximum and minimum annual income
earned by cultivating the said land?
National Rainfed Area Authority
†2271. DR. MURLI MANOHAR
JOSHI:
SHRI RAJ MOHINDER
SINGH MAJITHA:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
have proposed to set up a National Rain
Fed Area Authority to develop rain fed
agricultural land in the country;
(b) if so, the details of the proposal;
(c) the reasons for delay in imple-
mentation of this proposal; and
(d) by when the above proposal is likely
to be implemented?
NCF report
†2272. SHRI MOTILAL VORA:
MS. SUSHILA TIRIYA:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have received
the report from National Commission
constituted for farmers under the
chairmanship of agricultural scientist M.S.
Swaminathan;
(b) if so, the views of the Commission
regarding the plight of farmers and main
recommendations of this Commission;
(c) the reasons for abandoning
agriculture by farmers; and
(d) by when Government would take a
decision on the recommendations of this
Commission?
Establishing cotton research centres
2273. SHRI N.R. GOVINDARAJAR:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) the details of the efforts being made
by Government to encourage the cultivation
of international level quality of cotton in
the country;
(b) whether Government propose to
establish Cotton Research Centres in
various parts of the country; and
(c) if so, the details thereof?
Rejuvenation of agricultural sector
2274. SHRI SITARAM YECHURY:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether the National Commission
on Farmers has recommended five point
programme for rejuvenation of agricultural
sector;
(b) if so, whether Government have
prepared any plan of action; and
(c) if so, the details thereof and if not
the reasons therefor?
Special package for agrarian crisis
2275. SHRI SYED AZEEZ PASHA:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the
Government of Andhra Pradesh has sought
a Rs. 70,000 crore special package from
the Centre to deal with the agrarian crisis in
the State; and
(b) if so, the details of the package and
Government's reaction thereto?

525
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Boats for fishery sector
2276. DR. M.A.M. RAMASWAMY:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether representations have been
received from the Indian fishery sector to
help them in buying boats;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) the steps taken in this regard;
(d) whether it is a fact that stiff
conditions have been imposed making the
repayment schedule of only four years; and
(e) if so, the reasons therefor?
Agro-parks for preventing wastage of
agricultural produce
2277. SHRI C. RAMACHAND-
RAIAH: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware that
35-40 per cent of agro-produce is wasted
every year due to non-availability of proper
infrastructure in the country;
(b) if so, the details of agro-parks
available presently in the country, State-
wise;
(c) whether Government have approved
45 agro-parks, so far, out of which only
nine agro-parks are functioning;
(d) if so, the details thereof; and
(e) the details of financial assistance
provided by Government to each agro-
parks?
Agri-policy for rain fed area
2278. SHRI C. PERUMAL: Will the
Minister of AGRICULTURE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
have no agri-policy for the rain fed areas;
(b) if so, whether there is any proposal
to initiate an agri-policy for 60 per cent of
rain fed agricultural lands; and
(c) if not, the reasons therefor?
Increase in production of coarse grains
†2279. SHRI LALIT KISHORE
CHATURVEDI: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) per acre percentage of increase in
production of coarse grains like maize and
millet (Jawar and Bazra) registered during
the last fifty years;
(b) the reasons for such shortage; and
(c) the action being taken to enhance
per acre production of these significant
crops for livelihood of farmers of arid and
semi-arid areas?
National Crop Forecasting Centres
2280. SHRI VARINDER SINGH
BAJWA: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have set up
the National Crop Forecasting Centre;
(b) if so, the main purpose and function
of the centre; and
(c) the extent to which it has been
proved beneficial to farming community?
Reforms in agricultural education
†2281. SHRI RAVI SHANKAR
PRASAD:
DR. MURLI MANOHAR
JOSHI:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government

526
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
have assigned the responsibility of
comprehensive reforms in higher agricultural
education to the Indian Council of
Agricultural Research;
(b) if so, the facts in this regard;
(c) whether Government have also
prepared a proposal for bringing in reforms
in higher agricultural education;
(d) if so, the details thereof; and
(e) the assessment of the need of money
required to accomplish the task by the said
council?
Coverage of kharif crop
†2282. SHRI RAM JETHMALANI:
SHRI RAVI SHANKAR
PRASAD:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that agriculture
products grown for kharif crop during the
year 2006 were grown over a larger piece
of agriculture land than the one covered by
kharif crop last year;
(b) if so, the facts thereof and the total
area of agriculture land the kharif crop raised
on;
(c) the extent by which it is larger than
the one in last year; and
(d) the estimated agriculture production
due to larger agriculture land being used for
production?
Industries set up through KVIC in
Uttaranchal
2283. SHRI HARISH RAWAT: Will
the Minister of AGRO AND RURAL
INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:
(a) the details of Khadi, Woolen, Silky
soft fine woolen and Hasthkargaha, etc.
industries set up under various programmes
of Government through KVIC in
Uttaranchal during the last three years,
programme-wise and year-wise;
(b) the number of persons employed in
these industries in the State during the last
three years alongwith value of their
products; and
(c) the assistance Government are
providing to promote these industries in
the State?
Generation of special employment
through KVIC
†2284. SHRI JAI PARKASH
AGGARWAL:
SHRI KAMAL AKHTAR:
Will the Minister of AGRO AND
RURAL INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government propose to
generate special employment through
Khadi and Village Industries Commission
in the country;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether the above scheme is a part
of the target set for providing employment
by the Khadi and Village Industries
Commission; and
(d) if so, the details of funds sanctioned
under this scheme, as on date, State-wise;
Loans under PMRY
2285. SHRI RAMDAS AGARWAL:
